title: Reason Code 268/278: the client certificate has expired
plain_english: EAP-TLS: the certificate the device presented is past its validity period. One device failing while others work means that device stopped renewing; many devices failing on the same day means a template or auto-enrollment path broke months ago and the certificates are now aging out together.

any: certificate provided by the connecting user or computer is expired
certificate that was provided by the connecting user or computer is expired

causes.cause: The device certificate expired because auto-enrollment or MDM renewal stopped working.
causes.next_check: On the device, certlm.msc (computer) or certmgr.msc (user) shows the expiry; check the template's renewal period and the device's enrollment status (gpupdate /force, or the Intune/SCEP profile state).

causes.cause: Clock skew: the device or the NPS server has the wrong date, so a valid certificate looks expired.
causes.next_check: Compare the date and time on the failing device and on the NPS server before reissuing anything.
